purpose: Reviewed exceptions to the same-page supplier rule of 01_candidates.py. A generic product number (alias flagged 'needs the supplier on the same page') is admitted ONLY on the listed pages of the listed document (by SHA-256), after a reviewer verified document ownership and the product context. The rule is NOT relaxed for any other document: a supplier named somewhere else in a document is not sufficient. known_false_generic_matches lists reviewed hits that must never become links (check in 03_checks.py).
